scope: Every player id in library/careers/nba_player_careers.json with a 2003-04 to 2007-08 NBA season (760 ids). "players" lists non-U.S. nationals (not eligible for the USA). "special_cases" lists foreign-born U.S. nationals, U.S.-born players who represented or became eligible for another country, and dual citizens. Everyone else is treated as USA-eligible.
method: Basketball-Reference birthplace pages (https://www.basketball-reference.com/friv/birthplaces.fcgi?country=XX, every non-U.S. country, 92 pages) matched by bbr_id: 143 in-scope players born outside the 50 states.
Nationality and representation notes from the Wikipedia list of NBA players born outside the United States (matched by name; 141 of 143).
Wikidata country of citizenship (P27) for all 760 ids via the Basketball-Reference id (P2685) to find U.S.-born players with a second citizenship (43 found).
Each special case and doubtful foreign-born case checked against the player's English Wikipedia page (national-team sentences).
Puerto Rico players are U.S. citizens but represent Puerto Rico (its own FIBA member); they are listed under players (born in Puerto Rico) or special_cases (born in the 50 states).

field_notes.status: sourced = national team confirmed by the cited source; derived = nationality sourced, national team taken to be the country of nationality; unverified = doubtful, see note
field_notes.effective_from: special_cases only: the date the other nationality or first appearance became effective, when known. A simulation date before it should treat the player as USA-eligible (subject to the one-country rule).
field_notes.hindsight: Nationality and representation choices after the career date are hindsight about the player's later life; the simulation should read effective_from before applying a later choice.
